scenario_description:
Objective: Avoid an avoidable no-show on Elias’s scheduled senior-center shuttle after his Friday plan changes.
Emerging Need: A ride that is initially routine becomes risky only once Elias confirms he will skip the activity the van serves.
Decision Context: Early uncertainty makes cancellation inappropriate; the stored shuttle policy supplies the cutoff, consequence, and relay permission while the contact record supplies the desk route.
Consequence: If the cancellation window closes, the van remains assigned and Elias risks a service pause despite the family knowing he will not ride.
